proposals.before: When Empress Yi died, he added Heaven's punishment to his own: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, and clapped his hands in laughter and jest—the palace offices all heard of it.
proposals.after: When Empress Yi died, Heaven again punished him: he personally joined his attendants in grasping the mourning cords and singing aloud, pushed the inner coffin about, and clapped his hands in laughter and jest—the palace offices all heard of it.
proposals.reason: Chinese 重加天罰 makes Heaven the agent of further punishment; the idiomatic wrongly makes the emperor add punishment to himself.

decisions.reason: In 及懿后崩背，重加天罰 the further punishment is Heaven's (天罰), not something the emperor adds to himself; the idiomatic inverts the agent, and the proposed wording correctly restores Heaven as agent while keeping the funeral misconduct clauses intact.
